title: 第一卷 第2章 傻人有傻福，但傻逼没有
slug: 纨绔世子爷公主退婚我造反
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

轿辇稳稳停在醉红楼门前。

帘子一掀，一只纤细白皙的手伸了出来，搭在侍女的手背上。

紧接着，一个身着鹅黄宫装的女子款款走下轿辇。

陈炎望了过去，眼睛顿时看直了。

这女人肤若凝脂，眉如远黛，一双杏眼清澈如秋水，气质温婉中又透着几分皇家的雍容。

“这就是老子的那个前未婚妻啊？”

围观的百姓看见晋阳公主后，齐齐跪了一地。

周元更是腿一软，差点直接趴下去，但强撑着拱手行了个礼。

“臣……臣参见晋阳公主殿下。”

那几个跟着他的公子哥也慌了神，一个个跟鹌鹑似的缩在后面。

晋阳公主目光扫过在场众人，最后落在周元那张肿成猪头的脸上，微微蹙眉。

“这是怎么回事？”

周元刚想告状，陈炎却已经一个箭步蹿了出去，大声喊道：“公主殿下，您来得正好，我举报！”

他反手一指地上的周元，义正辞严：“这位周小侯爷，刚才当着咱们三百禁军，还有几百号京城热心群众的面，公然辱骂宁安公主是母老虎！”

全场寂静。

周元的眼珠子差点瞪出眼眶。

不是，我特么话都没说完，就被你一巴掌打断了啊！

你他妈还讲不讲武德？

“公主明鉴，他诽谤，他诽谤臣啊，臣真没说出口啊！”

周元急得嗓子都破音了。

陈炎一摊手，看向围观百姓。

“各位父老乡亲，他刚才说没说？”

百姓们互相看了看，犹豫了一下。

然后，异口同声的喊道：“说了！”

周元差点一口血喷出来。

晋阳公主的目光冷了下来，沉声道：“周元。”

“臣在！”

周元扑通一声跪了下去。

“宁安公主是本宫的皇妹，是天家公主。”

“议论皇家天女，永宁侯就是这么教你规矩的？”

周元的冷汗唰地就下来了。

他算是明白了，陈炎鼓动那些贱民做为证，今天不管他说没说，他都是说了。

“臣……臣知罪！臣口不择言，臣该死！”

“请公主殿下恕罪！请公主殿下恕罪！”

周元一个接一个的磕头。

那几个公子哥更是吓得脸都白了，齐刷刷跪了一排。

晋阳公主看了他一眼，淡淡地说：“回去告诉你父亲，让他好好管教你。若再有下次，本宫亲自上奏父皇。”

“是是是！臣谢公主殿下！谢公主殿下！”

周元连滚带爬地磕了好几个头，额头的血都糊了一脸，那模样别提多狼狈了。

处理完周元，晋阳公主转身看向陈炎，语气柔和了几分。

“陈世子，父皇让你进宫谢恩，你这就随我去吧。”

陈炎鼻子都快被气歪了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The sedan chair stopped steadily in front of Zuihonglou.

The curtain was lifted, and a slender white hand stretched out and rested on the back of the maid's hand.

Immediately afterwards, a woman in a goose-yellow palace dress stepped out of the sedan chair.

Chen Yan looked over and his eyes immediately straightened.

This woman's skin is like cream, her eyebrows are like distant daisy, her almond-shaped eyes are as clear as autumn water, her temperament is gentle and yet reveals a bit of royal grace.

"Is this my ex-fiancée?"

When the people watching saw Princess Jinyang, they all knelt on the ground.

Zhou Yuan's legs went weak and he almost fell down, but he held on and bowed with his hands.

"I...I see Her Royal Highness Princess Jinyang."

The young masters who were following him were also panicked, and they all shrank back like quails.

Princess Jinyang glanced at everyone present, and finally landed on Zhou Yuan's swollen pig-headed face, frowning slightly.

"What's going on?"

When Zhou Yuan just wanted to file a complaint, Chen Yan had already jumped out and shouted: "Your Highness, you are here just in time, I will report it!"

He pointed at Zhou Yuan on the ground with his backhand and said righteously: "This Lord Zhou, just now openly insulted Princess Ning'an as a tigress in front of our three hundred forbidden troops and hundreds of enthusiastic people in the capital!"

There was silence.

Zhou Yuan's eyes almost popped out of his sockets.

No, I didn’t even finish what I said when I was interrupted by your slap!

Do you still talk about martial ethics?

"Princess Mingjian, he slandered me, he slandered me, I really didn't say anything!"

Zhou Yuan was so anxious that his voice broke.

Chen Yan spread his hands and looked at the people watching.

"Dear fellow villagers, did he just say that?"

The people looked at each other and hesitated.

Then, they shouted in unison: "I said it!"

Zhou Yuan almost spit out a mouthful of blood.

Princess Jinyang's eyes turned cold and she said in a deep voice: "Zhou Yuan."

"I'm here!"

Zhou Yuan knelt down with a plop.

"Princess Ning'an is my royal sister and the princess of the Tian family."

"Talk about the Royal Goddess, is this how Marquis Yongning teaches you the rules?"

Zhou Yuan broke out in cold sweat.

He finally understood. Chen Yan encouraged those untouchables to serve as witnesses. Whether he said it or not, he said it today.

"I...I know I'm guilty! I don't hold back my words. I deserve to die!"

"Please forgive me, Your Highness Princess! Please forgive me, Your Highness Princess!"

Zhou Yuan kowtowed one after another.

The young masters were so frightened that their faces turned pale, and they all knelt down in a row.

Princess Jinyang glanced at him and said calmly: "Go back and tell your father and ask him to discipline you well. If there is another time, I will personally report to my father."

"Yes, yes! Thank you, Your Highness the Princess! Thank you, Your Highness the Princess!"

Zhou Yuan rolled around on the ground and kowtowed several times. The blood on his forehead was all over his face. He looked extremely embarrassed.

After dealing with Zhou Yuan, Princess Jinyang turned to look at Chen Yan, her tone a little softer.

"Chen Shizi, my father asked you to enter the palace to thank me. You can come with me now."

Chen Yan's nose was almost twisted with anger.
